infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Big Fella Athletics reads your running workouts from Apple Health to automatically log your runs and maintain your streak.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Big Fella Athletics saves completed runs and routes to Apple Health when Health Sync is enabled.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Big Fella Athletics uses your location to map and measure your runs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Big Fella Athletics records your route while a run is active, including when your phone is locked or the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to create a shareable run recap.
